note: FEF-041. clinicalKeys: strings whose wrong translation could mislead a patient about a prescription, a record category or an allergy; 'python3 scripts/ci/patient_catalogue.py check --release' fails while any of them lacks a native-clinician review in hi, kn or te. reviews: one entry per reviewed string {locale, ns, key, reviewerId, reviewedOn (ISO date), textSha (sha256 of the exact text reviewed)}. Entries are added only by the clinician's sign-off, never by the translator; a changed text makes its entry stale. Empty today: every hi/kn/te string is a machine draft. The clinical-key list is a proposal for the clinical owners to confirm.
